Define PRICE BRIEF DRIVE BRACE Zoom Agent PRICE · five traits of a brilliant freelancer with amnesia The freelancer Five traits AI P Probabilistic Outcome changes every time Give the same brief to a new freelancer, and get a different plan. prompt Outcome changes every time Give the same prompt in a new chat, and get a different answer. R Relentless High output, unknown quality Hand over the job, and they work day and night, producing stacks of polished pages, whether they’re right or not. High output, unknown quality Send the prompt, and it produces pages in seconds, as many as you ask for, whether they’re right or not. How we work here We always never Knowledgeable, but not about you Ask AI, trained on more text than anyone could read, and get the likeliest answer, blind to your company and culture. C Confident Fills the gap without question Give a vague request, and they start without asking, fill the gaps with their own assumptions, and sell it to you as right. Fills the gap without question Give a vague prompt, and it starts without asking, fills the gaps with the most common answers, and replies with full confidence. Amnesia: after each conversation, they forget everything, so you have to onboard them again, and every job starts from zero.
